caption: The drawing shows a rectangular quilt with a geometric, radiating pattern made up of zigzag stripes that form concentric diamond shapes. The central design consists of a multi-pointed star in the lower left corner, with segments colored pink, green, beige, and dark red, incorporating small floral and dotted prints. Expanding outward from the star, the quilt’s pattern consists of repeating rows of chevron-shaped blocks in alternating shades of pink, red, yellow, blue, green, and white, with a variety of small prints and textures visible in the fabric designs. The pattern covers roughly three-quarters of the rectangle, starting from the lower left corner and spreading diagonally upward and to the right. The remaining space along the top and right side is bordered by a wide band of yellow fabric with a dense floral print in green, red, white, and black. The background of the drawing is plain with a neutral beige color. The text “WESTCHESTER COUNTY” is written in the bottom left corner below the quilt, and the name “MAUD SCHMID” is written in the bottom right corner below the quilt.
title: Quilt - "Rising Sun"
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
